common.restricted_desc: This section is reserved for kingdom leadership (King and Officers). Log in with Discord to sync your role.
common.module_disabled_hint: This module is not enabled for this kingdom.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.power_history_empty_desc: The power and kill-points trend will build up as new scans come in.
dashboard.name: Name

war.tracker_subtitle: Manage your readiness and view kingdom status for the upcoming KvK.
war.form_description: Provide accurate data to help leadership plan for the upcoming KvK. Input resources in millions (e.g. 100 = 100M).
war.no_active_campaign: No active KvK campaign — declarations will reopen next season.
war.active_hours_hint: Your peak gaming window in UTC — when you will be most active during the KvK.
war.auth_required_desc: To maintain data integrity and prevent fake declarations, you must be logged in via Discord to declare your KvK availability.
war.auth_required_hint: Please use the login button in the top right header to authenticate.
war.filler_hint: Check your fillers and enter available T4/T5 troops for each.
war.leadership_only_desc: The War Dashboard and campaign goals are reserved for the King and Officers.
war.leadership_only_hint: Your declaration and personal goal are in "Me".

deadweight.title: Deadweight Tracking
deadweight.subtitle: Monitoring inactive or non-compliant accounts ({{count}} tracked)
deadweight.restricted_hint: The deadweight watchlist is reserved for kingdom leadership (King and Officers). Log in with Discord to sync your role.

profile.title: User Profile
profile.no_governor_linked: No governor linked yet. Find yourself to claim your stats!
profile.please_login: Please log in to view your profile.
profile.sync_roles_desc: Force update your permissions from the Discord server
profile.link_discord_desc: Link your Discord account to synchronize your in-app roles.
profile.no_accounts: No account claimed yet. Search to add your first account.

kvk_hub.subtitle: One hub — internal performance, progressions and coalition race
kvk_hub.domain_internal_note: Kingdom mains + fillers · not comparable to the race DKP
kvk_hub.domain_race_note: Based on camp scans · not comparable to the internal {{kingdom}} DKP
kvk_hub.upload_desc: Import the latest competition scan: the duel and all kingdoms on the map will be recomputed automatically.
kvk_hub.upload_ok: Scan uploaded — digesting (~10s), the view will refresh automatically.
kvk_hub.upload_bad_name: Filename does not match the scan convention (e.g. 002_1249539_06_16_2026,_11_07_14_AM.xlsx).

admin.subtitle: King only — data, KvK campaign, coalition race and maintenance
admin.maintenance_desc: Sensitive operations on war declarations. Every action requires an explicit confirmation.
admin.cfg_desc: Updating this form modifies the <0>Active Campaign</0>. All newly submitted declarations are bound to this campaign's ID. You can freely change the name without losing data.
admin.cfg_new_ready: Ready for a new campaign. Provide details and save.
admin.merge_confirm: Merge all data from "{{source}}" INTO the current Active Campaign "{{target}}"? This will move all declarations over.
admin.alert_confirm_mismatch: Confirmation text does not match the campaign name.
admin.alert_save_first: Save the active campaign configuration first before merging.
admin.alert_merge_self: Cannot merge a campaign into itself.
admin.cfg_filler_ratio_hint: 0.5 = fillers must lose 50% of their declared power (4×T4 + 10×T5).
admin.cfg_reveal_status_hint: While off, the Deadweight/Excellent labels stay hidden to avoid misreadings during the campaign.
admin.cal_desc: Schedule of the ongoing KvK's events (Passes, battles...). Visible to all members in the Goals tab. Times in UTC.
admin.cal_empty: No events yet. Add some, or shift the previous season's calendar.
admin.cal_shift_hint: Handy to reuse last season: shift everything by a number of days (times are kept).
admin.cal_mismatch: ⚠️ This calendar was entered for "{{name}}", not the current campaign. Shift it (below) or replace it, then save.
admin.cal_paste_desc: Paste your rows from Google Sheets (one per line: name + date/time UTC). Replaces the current list.

kvk_race.page_subtitle: Star race — camp duel, kingdoms and evolution
kvk_race.no_data: No race data yet. Upload a scan or check the configuration.
kvk_race.config_desc: Star-race parameters: camps, hero duel, race DKP weights and exclusions. No code changes between seasons.
kvk_race.our_camp_auto: Our camp: {{camp}} (from the « Us » role). Duel pre-filled from roles, editable.
kvk_race.dkp_hint: Coalition domain — never mixed with the internal {{kingdom}} DKP (BR-010).
kvk_race.excl_desc: Freezes a scope's progression between two scans (e.g. civil war).
kvk_race.players_empty: No top players for this scan.
kvk_race.snapshot_hint: Posts the duel to a channel after each scan ingestion. A config change never re-posts: only a new scan triggers the announcement.
kvk_race.efficiency_hint: Above the diagonal: delivering more than their power suggested.
kvk_race.efficiency_empty: Not enough power data for this scan.

kvk_history.select_player_hint: Search for a player to view their progression
kvk_history.archive_desc: Copies the current KvK performance data into the permanent history. An archived campaign can never be overwritten.
kvk_history.confirm_prompt: Archive "{{title}}" ({{mains}} main accounts, {{fillers}} fillers) as {{id}}? This cannot be undone.
kvk_history.already_archived: A campaign with this title is already archived.
kvk_history.no_current_data: No current KvK data to archive.
kvk_history.race_summary_hint: Freezes the final duel, camp standings, our rank and the top kingdoms into the archive. DKP weights are stored alongside: without them the figures become unreadable if the scale changes next season.

goals.power_from_campaign: Power at campaign start — it no longer moves once the KvK is running.
goals.power_from_profile: Current profile power, for lack of campaign data.
goals.min_kp_hint: Below this you are under the expected threshold.
goals.goal_kp_hint: This is what drives your status.
goals.min_dead_hint: ≈ {{troops}}k T5 troops ({{points}} pts per T5 dead). More if you lose T4s.
goals.warn_out_of_domain: Your power is below the scale's reliable range: these figures are indicative.
goals.warn_extrapolated: Your power is outside last season's observed range: figures are extrapolated.
goals.warn_fuzzy_rate: You are in the band where Good and Excellent overlapped last season — the status may be set by hand.
goals.footnote: Internal {{kingdom}} scale, indexed on power. Unrelated to the coalition race DKP.
goals.link_governor: Link your governor ID in your profile to see your goals.
goals.not_found: ID {{id}} does not appear in the kingdom data yet.
goals.empty_top: No reference data yet (base scan required).
goals.empty_campaign: Nobody has declared availability for this campaign yet.
goals.empty_self: You have not declared availability for this campaign yet — fill the form to see your target.
goals.login_required: Log in to see campaign goals.
goals.dead_points_note: Deads are counted in points (~{{points}} per T5 dead): losing T4s costs more troops for the same total.
goals.cause_unknown_id: ID not found in kingdom data (typo, or player outside the Top 300)
goals.cause_no_power: player known, but no power picked up by the sync
goals.status_hidden_notice: Status labels (Deadweight, Excellent…) will appear once the battles are over, when the King reveals them.

next_action.not_declared_desc: Leadership plans marches from declarations only.

error.title: Your figures may be out of date.

offcampaign.title: {{name}} is over. Nothing to declare.
offcampaign.title_generic: No campaign running. Nothing to declare.
offcampaign.desc: Leadership announces the next campaign here.

nogoal.title: Leadership hasn't published targets yet.
nogoal.desc: Goals are set from the power snapshot taken at Pass 1. Yours lands here as soon as it's out — nothing for you to do.

goal.reveal_note: Rating revealed once the fighting ends

pilotage.subtitle: War Dashboard, campaign goals and deadweight — leadership only.
